nodes.title: v0.25.0
nodes.body:
## Highlights

### Machines that fit your host

Cubic now looks at your CPU and memory before it creates or starts a machine.
Small laptops get a machine they can actually run, big workstations get a much
bigger one, and a machine that no longer fits is offered a size that does. You
can still set `--cpus` and `--memory` yourself whenever you want.

Machines also run on a full virtio device set now, which makes them faster and
lighter on the host.

### Change ports without a restart

`cubic modify --port` and `--rm-port` take effect immediately on a running
machine. Expose a live service and reach it a second later.

### Key only login

New machines drop the built in default password and log in by SSH key alone.
The account password is locked, so the credentials that used to be in the
source code no longer open anything. Serial console login now needs a password
you set yourself, and a new howto walks you through it. Names and usernames
are checked before they are used anywhere.

### A command line that talks back

Info, warn and error messages come with colored labels in the familiar cargo
style. SSH sessions show live spinners while connecting and logging in. `cubic
show` and `cubic ports` lead with what you need and keep the rest behind
`--all`, and `-v` gives you the full story when something looks off.

### Ready for scripts

Cubic reports success and failure to the shell, so CI and shell scripts can
branch on the exit code. Image listing keeps working when a mirror is slow,
delete finishes quickly, and disk sizes always match the real image.

### Easier to install and learn

Install on Windows with winget, or grab a ready to run binary for Linux amd64,
Linux arm64 and Windows amd64 from this release. A new documentation site adds
a getting started walkthrough and a troubleshooting guide.

nodes.title: v0.24.0
nodes.body:
## What's Changed ### Features - Prefer the cubic SSH key and deprecate other auth methods - Migrate deprecated YAML config to TOML on load - Show more details in the `show` command - Add `--kill` flag to the `stop` command - Locate QEMU modules and trim firmware blobs - Improve QEMU and firmware discovery - Secure the QEMU TCP sockets with mutual TLS - Communicate with QEMU over TCP sockets ### Fixes - Show the configured username in console credentials - Report crashed VMs as stopped - Keep the SSH port in sync with `instance.toml` - Show disk size for running instances - Use the canonical `ssh_authorized_keys` cloud-init key - Raise the web request timeout to 30 seconds - List Fedora images from the stable download host - Build instance paths with the native separator - Exit with code 0 when invoked without arguments or with `--help` - Run QEMU as a detached background process ### Refactoring - Remove the deprecated command argument from SSH - Consolidate QEMU code and let wrappers own their errors ### Documentation - Refresh project description and documentation - Add a security documentation page - Update copyright notice ### Chores - Update Rust dependencies - Remove the NASM dependency from the Windows build **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cubic/cubic/compare/v0.23.1...v0.24.0
This discussion was created from the release v0.24.0.

environment variables to the guest VM - Introduce Vulnlog for structured vulnerability tracking ### Bug Fixes - Surface port and SFTP failures as errors instead of panics - Propagate errors in SftpPath instead of panicking - Report missing QEMU executables clearly - Update russh to 0.60.3 to address CVE-2026-46673 ### Documentation - Add how-to guide for QEMU and firmware detection - Add how-to guide for passing environment variables to a VM - Add how-to guide for recovering data from a VM disk image - Add how-to guide for connecting via host SSH client - Add how-to guide for running an HTTP server in a VM - Add Architecture section explaining how Cubic works ### Misc - Validate PR commit messages - Update Rust dependencies ## What's Changed * Improve documentation structure and nodes.body:
## Highlights ### Features - Cubic is now packaged as a Debian package to simplify installation on Debian, Ubuntu, and derivatives. - Added a new subcommand to generate shell auto‑completion files (thanks to @tangowithfoxtrot). ### Fixes - Fixed the tilde (`~`) expansion in SCP paths (e.g., `mymachine:~/path/to/file`). - Fixed the error message shown when an SCP path does not exist. - Fixed the user‑password input for SSH, which was broken in the last release. ### Miscellaneous - OpenSSH was removed from the dependencies, as it is now completely replaced by Russh. - The spinner view now shows seconds and minutes. ## What's Changed * feat: remove openssh dependency by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/263 * feat: shell completions by @tangowithfoxtrot in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/262 * fix: support tilde expansion in scp paths by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/264 * doc: add make rule to generate command reference docs by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/265 * doc: update install documentation by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/266 * feat: publish snap on merge to main branch by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/267 * chore: improve pull‑request CI pipeline by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/268 * chore: manage RustSec suppressions in audit.toml by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/269 * feat: add CI pipeline for building .deb packages by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/270 * chore: build snaps on release‑tag creation by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/271 * fix: show error when SCP path does not exist by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/272 * chore: update Rust dependencies by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/273 * chore: use minimal Tokio feature set by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/274 * Fixes for Issues with (Ru)SSH by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/275 * Spinner minutes by @rogkne in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/277 ## New Contributors * @tangowithfoxtrot made their first contribution in https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/pull/262 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cubic-vm/cubic/compare/v0.18.0...v0.19.0
